note: The defaults, lexicographic and ascending, over digits, upper case, an underscore and lower case in order o1, and accented letters in o2. Java's String.compareTo orders by UTF-16 code unit: 10, 9, A, B, _, a, b and Z, e, f, é. A locale collation would put é beside e and a beside A. R1 joins the contexts S1 keeps, so All shows each context's order in turn. Observe in SAP PO (#33).
